name: react-spa

tools.install: install Node.js at the version the design names (the newest LTS release) from https://nodejs.org/ (it includes npm), and put it first on PATH
npm comes with Node.js: install Node.js at the version the design names from https://nodejs.org/ and put its bin folder first on PATH

setup: rm -rf node_modules || exit 1; if [ -f package.json ]; then exec npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; fi

checks.name: files
run: const { execFileSync } = require('child_process'); const list = (args) => execFileSync('git', [...args, '-z', '--', '.'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).split('\0').filter(Boolean); const problems = []; for (const file of list(['ls-files'])) if (file.split('/').includes('node_modules')) problems.push(file + ': committed inside a node_modules folder'); for (const file of list(['ls-files', '--cached', '--ignored', '--exclude-standard'])) problems.push(file + ': committed, but a .gitignore names it, so some checks skip it'); if (problems.length) { console.log(problems.join('\n')); process.exit(1); }

checks.name: packages
run: const fs = require('fs'); const problems = []; if (!fs.existsSync('package.json')) problems.push('no package.json'); if (fs.existsSync('npm-shrinkwrap.json')) problems.push('npm-shrinkwrap.json: npm installs from it instead of package-lock.json; use package-lock.json only'); const read = (file) => { try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')); } catch (error) { problems.push('no readable ' + file + ': ' + error.message); return null; } }; for (const file of ['package-lock.json', 'node_modules/.package-lock.json']) { const lock = read(file); if (!lock) continue; if (!(lock.lockfileVersion >= 2) || typeof lock.packages !== 'object' || lock.packages === null) { problems.push(file + ': not lockfile version 2 or 3 (npm 7 or later)'); continue; } for (const [key, entry] of Object.entries(lock.packages)) { if (key === '' || entry.inBundle) continue; const where = file + ': ' + key + ': '; if (!key.startsWith('node_modules/') && !key.includes('/node_modules/')) { problems.push(where + 'a local folder or workspace, whose code the gate does not check'); continue; } if (entry.link) { problems.push(where + 'a link to a local folder'); continue; } const name = key.replace(/^.*node_modules\//, ''); const url = 'https://registry.npmjs.org/' + name + '/-/' + name.split('/').pop() + '-' + entry.version + '.tgz'; if (entry.resolved !== url) problems.push(where + 'not from the npm registry under its own name and version (resolved: ' + entry.resolved + ')'); if (typeof entry.integrity !== 'string' || !entry.integrity) problems.push(where + 'no integrity hash'); } } if (problems.length) { console.log(problems.join('\n')); process.exit(1); }

checks.name: format
run: config=; for name in .prettierrc .prettierrc.json .prettierrc.json5 .prettierrc.yaml .prettierrc.yml .prettierrc.toml .prettierrc.js .prettierrc.mjs .prettierrc.cjs .prettierrc.ts .prettierrc.mts .prettierrc.cts prettier.config.js prettier.config.mjs prettier.config.cjs prettier.config.ts prettier.config.mts prettier.config.cts; do if [ -f "$name" ]; then config=$name; break; fi; done; if [ -n "$config" ]; then set -- --config "$config"; else set -- --no-config; fi; exec node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check --no-editorconfig "$@" .

checks.name: lint
run: config=; for name in eslint.config.js eslint.config.mjs eslint.config.cjs eslint.config.ts eslint.config.mts eslint.config.cts; do if [ -f "$name" ]; then config=$name; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$config" ]; then echo 'no ESLint config (eslint.config.*) in the part folder'; exit 1; fi; node -e "const { execFileSync } = require('child_process'); const { ESLint } = require('./node_modules/eslint'); const config = process.argv[1]; const files = execFileSync('git', ['ls-files', '-z', '--', '.'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).split('\\0') .filter((file) => /\\.(js|jsx|mjs|cjs|ts|tsx|mts|cts)$/.test(file)); (async () => { const linter = new ESLint({ overrideConfigFile: config }); const unignored = new ESLint({ overrideConfigFile: config, ignore: false }); const problems = []; for (const file of files) { if (!(await unignored.calculateConfigForFile(file))) { problems.push(file + ': no ESLint config applies to it'); continue; } if (await linter.isPathIgnored(file)) continue; const rules = Object.values((await linter.calculateConfigForFile(file)).rules || {}); if (!rules.some((rule) => ![0, 'off'].includes(Array.isArray(rule) ? rule[0] : rule))) problems.push(file + ': no ESLint rule is on for it'); } if (problems.length) { console.log(problems.join('\\n')); process.exit(1); } })().catch((error) => { console.log(String(error)); process.exit(1); });" "$config" || exit 1; if [ -e eslint-suppressions.json ]; then echo 'eslint-suppressions.json turns lint errors off without an ADR'; exit 1; fi; exec node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --config "$config" .

checks.name: test
run: config=; for name in vitest.config.ts vitest.config.mts vitest.config.cts vitest.config.js vitest.config.mjs vitest.config.cjs; do if [ -f "$name" ]; then config=$name; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$config" ]; then echo 'no Vitest config (vitest.config.*) in the part folder'; exit 1; fi; exec node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config "$config" --allowOnly=false --passWithNoTests=false

count_tests: if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo 0; exit 0; fi; config=; for name in vitest.config.ts vitest.config.mts vitest.config.cts vitest.config.js vitest.config.mjs vitest.config.cjs; do if [ -f "$name" ]; then config=$name; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$config" ]; then echo 'no Vitest config (vitest.config.*) in the part folder'; exit 1; fi; list=$(mktemp) || exit 1; trap 'rm -f "$list"' EXIT; out=$(node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs list --config "$config" --json="$list" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out"; exit 1; }; node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const tests = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], 'utf8')); if (!Array.isArray(tests)) { console.log('vitest list did not give a list'); process.exit(1); } console.log(tests.length);" "$list"

read: const text = require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8'); if (!text.trim()) process.exit(0); const lock = JSON.parse(text); const names = ["typescript", "@types/react", "@types/react-dom", "@types/node", "eslint", "@eslint/js", "typescript-eslint", "eslint-plugin-react-hooks", "eslint-plugin-react-refresh", "globals", "prettier", "vitest", "jsdom", "@testing-library/react", "@testing-library/dom", "@testing-library/user-event", "@testing-library/jest-dom", "@playwright/test", "playwright", "playwright-core"]; const scopes = ["@typescript-eslint/", "@vitest/", "@eslint/"]; for (const [key, entry] of Object.entries(lock.packages || {})) { if (!key.includes('node_modules/')) continue; const name = key.replace(/^.*node_modules\//, ''); const shown = key === 'node_modules/' + name ? name : key; if (names.includes(name) || scopes.some((scope) => name.startsWith(scope))) console.log(shown + ' ' + entry.version); }

const text = require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8'); if (!text.trim()) process.exit(0); const lock = JSON.parse(text); for (const [key, entry] of Object.entries(lock.packages || {})) { if (key === '' || !entry || !entry.hasInstallScript) continue; console.log(key.replace(/^.*node_modules\//, '') + '@' + entry.version); }
installed: const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); if (!fs.existsSync('package-lock.json')) process.exit(0); const lock = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package-lock.json', 'utf8')); const problems = []; for (const [key, entry] of Object.entries(lock.packages || {})) { if (!entry || entry.link || (!key.startsWith('node_modules/') && !key.includes('/node_modules/')) || key.split('/').includes('..')) continue; let manifest; try { manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(key, 'package.json'), 'utf8')); } catch (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') continue; problems.push(key + ': no readable package.json: ' + error.message); continue; } const scripts = (manifest && manifest.scripts) || {}; const found = ['preinstall', 'install', 'postinstall'].filter((name) => scripts[name]); if (!scripts.install && !scripts.preinstall && manifest.gypfile !== false && (fs.statSync(path.join(key, 'binding.gyp'), { throwIfNoEntry: false }) || { isFile: () => false }).isFile()) found.push('node-gyp rebuild (it has a binding.gyp)'); if (found.length && !entry.hasInstallScript) problems.push(key + ': runs ' + found.join(', ') + ' on install, but package-lock.json does not mark it with hasInstallScript'); } if (problems.length) console.log(problems.join('\n'));

versions: node --version | sed 's/^/node /'; npm --version | sed 's/^/npm /'; node -e "for (const name of ['vite', 'vitest', 'eslint', 'typescript', 'prettier']) { let version = 'not installed'; try { version = require('./node_modules/' + name + '/package.json').version; } catch {} console.log(name + ' ' + version); }"
